# Conditional Fields

A field can show only while other fields have certain values. Give its variable an `x-show-when`, mapping the other variables' names to the value, or list of values, each must have:

```yaml
- name: IdentitySubscriptionId
  type: string
  x-show-when:
    SubscriptionLayout: caf
```

While a field is hidden, the form doesn't ask for it: a `required` one doesn't stop you generating, and the template gets the field's default (empty when it has none), not a value you entered before it hid. A section whose fields are all hidden doesn't appear.

## Choose a contact method

The field for the address shows only for the method you pick.

<Inputs id="contact">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: ContactMethod
    type: enum
    options: [email, slack]
    default: email
  - name: EmailAddress
    type: string
    validations:
      - required
    x-show-when:
      ContactMethod: email
  - name: SlackChannel
    type: string
    validations:
      - required
    x-show-when:
      ContactMethod: slack
```
</Inputs>

<Command
  id="show-contact"
  outputs={["contact"]}
  inputsId="contact"
  title="Show the contact"
  env={{ METHOD: "{{ .inputs.ContactMethod }}", EMAIL: "{{ .inputs.EmailAddress }}", CHANNEL: "{{ .inputs.SlackChannel }}" }}
  command='echo "contact=$METHOD:$EMAIL$CHANNEL" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"'
/>

## Lay out the subscriptions

This template's `boilerplate.yml`:

- Shows the **CAF Subscriptions** section only when **Subscription Layout** is `caf`. With `single`, the section disappears and its required fields don't stop you generating.
- Shows **Firewall Sku** only when the layout is `caf` and **Deploy Firewall** is checked. Uncheck it and `subscriptions.yml` gets the default tier, `Standard`, whatever you picked.

Generate it, switch the layout, and look at `subscriptions.yml`.

<Template id="subscriptions" path="templates/subscriptions" />
